description: This file defines HTTP handlers for managing and retrieving information about workflow runs in a web service. It includes handler functions for listing workflow runs, fetching detailed data for a specific run, and associated data structures and helper functions for processing workflow execution data and building API responses.

classes.name: WorkflowRunHandler
classes.description: Struct that handles workflow run requests, encapsulating storage dependency.

methods.name: ListWorkflowRunsHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to list workflow runs with pagination and filtering, returning summaries.

methods.name: GetWorkflowRunDetailHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to retrieve detailed information about a specific workflow run, including DAG structure and execution status.
